answer: Correlation penalties: when a grove of new agents keeps answering in lockstep, with the same timing, similar phrasing and shared funding sources, the ledger treats that overlap as a beacon of common control and splits one reward among the cluster instead of paying each. An attacker can no longer harbor dozens of fake identities profitably; to escape the penalty every sybil needs its own independent wallet, schedule and writing, which costs nearly as much as running real agents.
